title: Sacks of Salt for the Innkeeper
summary: Larkin Antler wants 2 sacks of salt from the smokehouse yard taken to Clem Wythe before the pelt buyers come through, and then a word.
offer_text: "We need sacks of salt, and what is stacked at the smokehouse yard is the town's to take. Carry it to Clem Wythe before the pelt buyers come through, then come and tell me."
turn_in_text: "Good. That is one thing in Frostmere that goes right."

objectives.text: Take 2 sacks of salt from the pile
Hand the sacks of salt to Clem Wythe
Tell Larkin Antler it is done

relationship.label: Ran an errand for the town
